arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
translation: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
translation: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there any equal to Him.

arabic: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
translation: Your god is one God; there is no deity but He, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. The Verse of the Throne.

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
translation: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
translation: Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation: Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translation: Whoever fears Allah, He will make a way out for him, and provide for him from where he does not expect.

arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ
translation: And He is with you wherever you are.

arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
translation: But Allah is the best Guardian, and He is the most Merciful of the merciful.

arabic: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
translation: Inform My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation: And that there is nothing for man except what he strives for.

arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
translation: My success is only through Allah. Upon Him I rely, and to Him I turn.

arabic: ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
translation: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

arabic: وَبَشِّرِ الصَّابِرِينَ
translation: And give good tidings to the patient.

arabic: وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ
translation: Cooperate in righteousness and piety, and do not cooperate in sin and aggression.

arabic: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ
translation: Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.

arabic: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا
translation: Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and that you be good to parents.

arabic: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
translation: So be patient with beautiful patience.

arabic: وَعَسَىٰ أَن تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ
translation: Perhaps you dislike a thing while it is good for you.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ
translation: Indeed, Allah commands justice, good conduct, and giving to relatives.

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
translation: I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation: And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: Indeed, Allah loves those who do good.

arabic: وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ
translation: And remember your Lord when you forget.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
translation: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake.

arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, and ease for me my task.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves; if You do not forgive us and have mercy, we will surely be among the losers.

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
translation: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
translation: Our Lord, grant us comfort in our spouses and offspring, and make us a model for the righteous.

arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and make our steps firm.

arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity but He. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Glory be to Allah and His is the praise; glory be to Allah the Magnificent.

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You well.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
translation: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad (peace be upon him) as Prophet.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
translation: O Allah, You are Pardoning and Generous; You love to pardon, so pardon me.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and the praise, and He is able to do all things.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant as best I can. (Master of seeking forgiveness)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, and from incapacity and laziness.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and the evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the resurrection.

arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translation: Actions are but by intentions, and each person will have only what they intended.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

arabic: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
translation: Religion is sincere good counsel.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
translation: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.

arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
translation: Part of a person's excellence in Islam is leaving what does not concern him.

arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
translation: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good one to erase it; and treat people with good character.

arabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ
translation: Purification is half of faith.

arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: Your smile in your brother's face is a charity for you.

arabic: مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُ النَّاسَ لَا يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ
translation: Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah will not show mercy to him.

arabic: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: A good word is a charity.

arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
translation: The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.

arabic: لَا تَغْضَبْ
translation: Do not become angry.

arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
translation: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though in each there is good.

arabic: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
translation: Whoever guides someone to good has a reward like the one who does it.

arabic: الْحَيَاءُ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَّا بِخَيْرٍ
translation: Modesty brings nothing but good.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
translation: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.

arabic: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: Every act of kindness is a charity.

arabic: اطْلُبُوا الْعِلْمَ مِنَ الْمَهْدِ إِلَى اللَّحْدِ
translation: Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave. (A well-known saying)

arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى الْبَرْدَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
translation: Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Fajr and Asr) will enter Paradise.

arabic: الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ
translation: Righteousness is good character.
